title: Dependable answers 2 (D-059-R003 completion): remove the hardcoded ZR 23-21 section label from the five live-wired scenario-analysis modules (derive/breakeven/comparison/ranking/sensitivity)
objective: Complete D-059-R003 across the scenario-analysis surface the M5-T027 packet could not reach. The accepted M5-T027 fix derived the cap section label from the actually-evaluated rule in constants.py/builder.py, but five sibling modules - all reachable through the LIVE scenario_analysis.py endpoint (main.py mounts scenario_analysis_v1_router) - still hardcode 'ZR 23-21' regardless of the district family evaluated: derive.py:82 (DERIVED_RANGE_LABEL, emitted UNCONDITIONALLY as the label of every derived_practical_usable_range document - not a fallback), breakeven.py:155, comparison.py:118 and :129, ranking.py:114, and sensitivity.py:128. Requirement: the displayed ZR section reference in each of these surfaces must be DERIVED from the rule actually evaluated for the subject property (the R6-R12 family cites ZR 23-22), reusing the M5-T027 derivation seam rather than introducing a second mechanism; where a surface genuinely has no evaluated-rule context available at the point the string is built, it must either take the derived value from its caller or state the section generically WITHOUT naming a specific ZR section - never assert 23-21 by default. Keep every other word of these labels intact (they are reviewed provenance prose): this is a section-reference correction, not a rewrite. Response schema shape and enums stay byte-compatible (packages/** FORBIDDEN; the contracts-typegen and contracts-schema-bundle CI jobs must stay green) and no rule file is touched. Add tests asserting the derivation for BOTH a low-density (23-21) and an R6-R12 (23-22) district on each affected document, hand-derived from the real ruleset files rather than by calling the code under test. Zero new dependencies. Producer report to project-control/reports/M5-T028-producer-report.md.
business_reason: M5-T027 G3 advisory A1 (independent reviewer): the D-059-R003 stale-label defect class is only partially resolved - five modules reachable through the live scenario_analysis.py endpoint still hardcode 'ZR 23-21' regardless of the district family actually evaluated, and derive.py's DERIVED_RANGE_LABEL is emitted unconditionally on every derived_practical_usable_range document. Closing this is required before R003 can be claimed resolved project-wide
